P3_odd_rungs_interpolate.note: RETIRED by operator election 2026-08-30. There is no wind-rung term in the gust lineage, so a (seed, trajectory) draws a bit-identical gust stream at every rung in its group -- Group A {0,2,4,6,8} m/s, Group B {1,3,5,7}, verified 60/60 identical (F8). This limb compares Group B against Group A and is therefore CONFOUNDED BY CONSTRUCTION: it cannot separate aliasing from the gust split. Per-cell rates are unaffected (60 distinct draws per cell); only cross-rung inference is. Retired, not reinterpreted.

caveats: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY (BASELINE025_PREREG SS9.6): ARM-B is a reference description of one controller; it tests no hypothesis, confirms nothing and enters no alpha-graph node.

Legs are NOT independent: the same 30 seeds fly every rung and both trajectories, so a seed contributes 20 legs. Every rate carries a leg-level interval AND a seed-clustered one with the realised design effect; neither extreme is assumed (SS9.3).
Rates are the CLEAN/ALL bracket. The CLEAN screen is outcome-correlated and inflates whatever rate it is pointed at; quoting either alone would be a claim.
Emergency-abort accounting is LEG-LEVEL. The SAP's +-1.0 s window needs tick-level abort times this corpus does not carry, so the windowed rates read NOT MEASURED.

Perception-vs-truth is NOT computed here: the canonical estimator needs paired_tick_log_env0.jsonl, absent from this corpus. Any figure from the paired same-tick frame would be NON-CANONICAL and is withheld rather than substituted.
SS11(a): the realized-sigma band scales with sigma, so at 0.35 it is 0.1118 -- LOOSER than A-10's signed 0.10. Registered before the legs flew, not repaired here.
Substrate provenance is UNVERIFIED: no per-episode cold-boot witness exists in this corpus, so the warm-pool contamination class is reported unverified, never excluded.
Fisher's exact is NOT used for the paired sigma contrast (it discards the pairing) and scripts/defense_statistical_analysis.py is not imported, run or cited.
